title: Zebra Technologies to Present at Citi's 2026 Global Technology, Media & Telecom Conference
summary: Read this article to learn when Zebra is presenting at Citi's 2026 Global Technology, Media & Telecom Conference in New York, N.Y.
body_markdown:
**LINCOLNSHIRE, Ill. ─ Sept. 2, 2026** ─[Zebra Technologies Corporation](https://www.zebra.com/us/en.html) (NASDAQ: ZBRA), a global leader in digitizing and automating workflows to deliver intelligent operations, today announced that the company will present at Citi's 2026 Global Technology, Media & Telecom Conference in New York, N.Y., on Wed., Sept. 9 at 8:10 a.m. U.S. eastern time.


To listen to the live webcast of the presentation, please visit the Events section of the company’s website at[investors.zebra.com](http://investors.zebra.com/) , where it will also be archived for replay.


**WHO IS ZEBRA TECHNOLOGIES?**


Zebra (NASDAQ: ZBRA) provides the foundation for intelligent operations with an award-winning portfolio of connected frontline, asset visibility and automation solutions which empower our customers to deploy AI on the frontline. Organizations globally across retail, manufacturing, transportation, logistics, healthcare, and other industries rely on us to deliver outcomes today while driving innovation for what’s next. Together with our partners, we create new ways of working that improve productivity and empower organizations to be better every day **.** Learn more at[www.zebra.com](https://www.zebra.com/us/en.html) .


Follow Zebra on our[Blog](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/blog.html) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/zebra-technologies/mycompany/) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ZebraTechnologiesGlobal/) ,[X](https://x.com/zebratechnology) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatzebra) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/%40ZebraTechnologiesGlobal) .
